title: A warning before memory runs out
text: When the PC's memory is nearly full, a message says so and names the app that would be closed, so there's time to save your work.

title: Fewer freezes
text: When the PC runs out of memory, KantanOS closes the app using the most of it, instead of the whole PC freezing, and says which app it was.

title: Japanese TV on the start screen
text: Wakaru TV has its own tile and menu entry. The first time, it downloads itself.

title: Android apps tidied away
text: Android apps are no longer in the menu or Welcome: most Play Store games don't work with them.

title: Easier shortcuts
text: Making a shortcut on the start screen: type a website's name ("CBC News") and press Look it up, no web address needed.

title: Kan-chan from head to toe
text: The Kan-chan app shows her whole body, like the Helper does.
